free_tier.stated: Free: One configuration setting, One forwarding rule, Random external port, Auto-generated domain name

egress.terms: 'Unlimited bandwidth' is a core feature line on the product page; no rate or tolerance is published; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: OpenVPN config or SSH key plus a mapping rule created in the dashboard or by the API
tooling: OpenVPN or SSH plus the portmap.io REST API and client
chaining: one rule is one port, so it composes with exactly one WireGuard interface

limits.value: unlimited bandwidth stated, no rate published

binding_note: The byte allowance is unlimited by statement, so the first real failure is that the free plan's external port is random and custom external ports are a Premium feature. That is a paywall on the one property a WireGuard endpoint needs, and it is not one of the seven vocabulary kinds.

identity_cost.detail: an account that generates an OpenVPN configuration or SSH key: 'Create a configuration file for OpenVPN or SSH key using the Generate button'

reliability_note: the free rule's external port is allocated by the operator and can in principle be reassigned; the tunnel is an OpenVPN session that must stay up
confidence_note: Whether the random port survives a reconnect is not stated anywhere on the site, which is the open question that decides the verdict. Raise by creating a free rule, noting the port, restarting the VPN, and reading the port again.

evidence.proved: free plan is one rule with a random external port; Premium USD 3.99/month adds custom external ports; 'Unlimited bandwidth'; TCP or UDP forwarding over OpenVPN
'What ports can I forward on Premium plan? The port number must be in range [1024-65535] and not occupied by another user', and 'Basic plan which allows only one mapping rule is unlimited'

notes: The free tier is generous on bytes and stingy on the one thing that matters here. Re-read 2026-10-23: the 1024-65535 port range rule applies to Premium custom ports, and the free rule stays a random port.

extras.wg_detail: the rule forwards UDP: 'You can forward HTTP traffic to your local web-server as well as any TCP or UDP traffic.' The public port is random on the free plan and chosen on Premium.
extras.volume_stated: 'Unlimited bandwidth' is a core feature line on the product page; no rate or tolerance is published
extras.transit_note: the portmap.io server terminates the VPN and forwards the rule's traffic
